relationships.subject: notochordal cell-secreted factors
relationships.evidence_quote: It has been confirmed by several groups that conditioned media obtained from notochordal cell tissue culture confers anabolic, anti-apoptotic, and anti-catabolic effects on cells derived from the IVD NP

key_findings: Notochordal cells secrete factors with anabolic, anti-inflammatory and anti-apoptotic effects on IVD nucleus pulposus cells.
These cues are candidates for molecular therapy of degenerative disc disease.
